baseline_quote: the primary studies on which the principal conclusions rest were read in full; The evidence ledger states the depth for every cited source
scientific_reason: The supplied ledger represents 69 of 94 active citekeys and its referenced full-text files are absent, so this revision cannot reproduce the blanket depth claim.
supporting_evidence: Ledger audit: 135 rows; 69 unique citekeys; 75 full_text rows; 0/75 referenced paths exist in supplied package.
effect_on_interpretation: Readers may overestimate reproducibility and reading coverage.
minimum_remedy: State the supplied-ledger boundary and fresh targeted checks; do not claim every active citation was full-text verified.

baseline_quote: The one independent test against a prescribed focal scar preserved slice-averaged circumferential strain better than radial strain
scientific_reason: The source reports slice-average errors, not scar-region recovery; 'preserved' overstates the endpoint.
supporting_evidence: MRXCAT2.0 Fig. 14/results: averages of three mid-ventricular slices; no scar-region error.
effect_on_interpretation: Could be read as proof that focal scar magnitude was recovered.
minimum_remedy: Describe lower reported slice-average circumferential error and explicitly deny scar-level recovery inference.

baseline_quote: the per-case standard deviations overlap, so the ordering rests on the full set of panels
scientific_reason: Overlap of descriptive SDs is neither a significance nor equivalence test; no between-case inference was reported.
supporting_evidence: MRXCAT2.0 reports means±SD and qualitative lowest-performance wording, without a between-case test.
minimum_remedy: Replace with 'no between-case inferential comparison was reported; these summaries do not establish a ranking'.

baseline_quote: radial and circumferential strain are largely abolished
scientific_reason: Remote-to-scar changes differ by component (0.95→0.30 radial; −0.18→0.01 circumferential); qualitative wording hides magnitude and sign.
supporting_evidence: MRXCAT2.0 full text, cardiac functional model results.
effect_on_interpretation: May imply near-zero radial strain when 0.30 remains.
minimum_remedy: Give the numeric changes or say radial markedly reduced and circumferential near zero.

baseline_quote: statistically equivalent ... within a prespecified margin of 3.5%
scientific_reason: The source calls the margin selected, reports mean difference −2.7 percentage points, p<0.001 and d=−0.89 alongside TOST equivalence.
supporting_evidence: Jahromi et al. 2026 full text, Results lines 301-308.
effect_on_interpretation: A reader may interpret equivalence as absence of systematic difference.
minimum_remedy: Report selected margin, mean difference and the simultaneous significant difference; keep component/layer/healthy scope.

baseline_quote: The one independent prescribed-focal test retrieved
scientific_reason: Uniqueness is only established within a capped targeted search plus citation expansion.
supporting_evidence: Historical search log: two broad queries capped at 100; no duplicate screening.
minimum_remedy: Use 'the only such test identified within the recorded search'.

baseline_quote: focal peak-time error against a material reference remains untested
scientific_reason: An absolute absence claim exceeds the recorded search coverage.
supporting_evidence: Historical search boundary and no systematic-review protocol.
effect_on_interpretation: May overstate certainty about missing literature.
minimum_remedy: Use 'was not identified in the recorded search'.

baseline_quote: chronological catalogue of numerous estimator papers
scientific_reason: Method-lineage detail partly duplicates Supplementary Table S3 and dilutes the validation question.
effect_on_interpretation: The review's central evidence synthesis arrives late.
minimum_remedy: Condense examples to assumption-changing families and move catalogue detail to the supplement.

baseline_quote: 14 of 48 entries ... one independent synthetic evaluation
scientific_reason: Counts rely partly on abstract/metadata-level classifications and a bespoke counting rule that splits multi-study rows.
effect_on_interpretation: The exact count may look more objective than the underlying classification.
minimum_remedy: Label as classifications of reviewed entries; retain audit rule and avoid treating counts as prevalence estimates.

baseline_quote: ICC, bias, AUC, EPE and coefficient of variation presented in adjacent synthesis
scientific_reason: These metrics answer different questions and use different units/analysis levels.
supporting_evidence: Study measurement contracts and manuscript's own validation hierarchy.
effect_on_interpretation: Readers may infer method ranking across incomparable endpoints.
minimum_remedy: Strengthen endpoint labels and avoid cross-row ranking language.

baseline_quote: At minimum, studies should show bias and limits of agreement, spatial localisation error, extent error, timing error...
scientific_reason: Reads as a universal requirement although relevance depends on intended claim.
effect_on_interpretation: May unfairly judge studies that did not claim all four attributes.
minimum_remedy: Condition the list on the claimed attributes and intended use.

baseline_quote: A validation programme for regional or focal claims
scientific_reason: Recommendations could be mistaken for evidence-backed validated procedure.
supporting_evidence: No new experiment was conducted; framework is author synthesis.
effect_on_interpretation: May elevate proposal to established standard.
minimum_remedy: Label explicitly as proposed programme and distinguish essential claim-matching from optional stages.
